inlines.v: CAREFULLY, adverb 1. With care, anxiety, or solicitude. Though he sought it carefully with tears. Hebrews 12:17. 2. Heedfully; watchfully; attentively; as, consider these precepts carefully If thou carefully hearken to the Lord. Deuteronomy 9:1. 3. In a manner that shows care. Envy, how carefully does it look. Collier. 4. Providently; cautiously..
